name: rps-dev
description: Nur Dev-Werkzeuge (Tests). Nichts davon landet in public/.

scripts.secrets: docker compose --profile tools run --rm -T gitleaks git --redact --no-banner --config .gitleaks.toml . && docker compose --profile tools run --rm -T gitleaks dir --redact --no-banner --config .gitleaks.toml public tests docs
scripts.test:php: docker compose --profile tools run --rm -T php php tests/run.php
scripts.lint:php: docker compose --profile tools run --rm -T php sh -c 'for f in $(find public tests -name "*.php"); do php -l "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done && echo PHP-Lint ok'
